entities.name: Lujo Tončić-Sorinj

entities.summary: Lujo Tončić-Sorinj was an Austrian diplomat and politician of the conservative Austrian People's Party (ÖVP). He served as Foreign Minister from 1966 to 1968 and as Secretary General of the Council of Europe from 1969 to 1974.
